title: H3-metal – Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon
summary: This project ports the H3 (Hierarchical Hexagonal Geospatial) indexing algorithm's inference capabilities to run natively on Apple Silicon using Metal GPU framework, enabling efficient vector embedding computations on M-series chips without CPU bottlenecks.
problem_solved: Enables native GPU-accelerated H3 embedding inference on Apple MacBooks, replacing slow CPU-only computations with Metal-based parallel processing.
why_valuable: Provides significant performance gains for location-based AI/ML applications on Mac hardware while leveraging Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture.
